option.counterfactual: Strictness does not persist under increasing rank: for some n≥4 and c≥3, γ_c(IA_n)∩A_{c+1}(n)=γ_{c+1}(IA_n), even though strictness holds in rank three.
option.approach: Separate the established rank-three results from the higher-rank claims and investigate rank-dependent relations among Magnus generators. Such relations could explain why a kernel element survives in IA_3 but vanishes after stabilization.
